You are fixing a bug in the Python repository in the current working directory. The bug and the required behavior are described below. Read the relevant source files, make the necessary code edits to the source (do NOT edit the tests), and use the shell to run the tests to confirm your fix. Keep changes minimal.

ISSUE:
Composed queries cannot change the list of columns with values()/values_list().
Description
	
Composed queries cannot change the list of columns when values()/values_list() is evaluated multiple times, e.g.
>>> ReservedName.objects.create(name='a', order=2)
>>> qs1 = ReservedName.objects.all()
>>> print(qs1.union(qs1).values_list('name', 'order').get())
('a', 2)
>>> print(qs1.union(qs1).values_list('order').get())
('a', 2)
(see ​compiler.py#L428-L433).


The test suite lives in tests/. You can run it with: python -m pytest -q
When the tests pass, you are done.

The fix passes. The root cause: `set_values` was mutating the persistent combined query object, so on a second evaluation `compiler.query.values_select` was already populated and the new column list was ignored. Cloning the query before setting values keeps the original combined query clean, so each evaluation applies the current `values()`/`values_list()` columns.
